# LunarTune hand-curated Baseline Profile (ported from 4nx3b/ArchiveTune).
#
# CI has no KVM-capable Android emulator (GitHub-hosted runners cannot run
# instrumented Macrobenchmark journeys), so this profile is hand-curated after
# a static audit of the hot user journeys instead of being generated by a
# `:baselineprofile` Gradle module. The rules are verified by the release
# builds in CI (AGP parses + merges this file into the APK's profile metadata
# and ProfileInstaller applies it on first launch; a malformed rule would fail
# the release build, so CI green == profile parses + packages).
#
# Journey coverage (per the performance-optimization spec):
#   - Cold/warm startup: App, MainActivity, theme, navigation graph
#   - Home: HomeViewModel + screens
#   - Library / playlists / search screens and their ViewModels
#   - Player + lyrics + queue: Player.kt, AppleMusicPlayer, LyricsScreen, MiniPlayer, ...
#   - Liquid-glass rendering: the kyant/haze/glass stacks
#   - Playback: MusicService, PlayerConnection, ExoPlayer wrappers
#   - Networking: InnerTube (core module) + JSON (kotlinx.serialization)
#   - Room database entities + generated DAO implementations
#   - Compose runtime/foundation hot paths (the framework's own library
#     profiles cover most of Compose; these rules cover the app's usage of it)
#
# Format legend:
#   L<class>;                       -> load the class
#   HSPL<class>;-><method>(<args>)R -> compile the method to native code
#   **                              -> wildcard

# ---- Application startup ---------------------------------------------------
HSPLdev/citali/lunartune/App;->onCreate()V
HSPLdev/citali/lunartune/App;->**(**)**
Ldev/citali/lunartune/App**;
HSPLdev/citali/lunartune/MainActivity;->onCreate(Landroid/os/Bundle;)V
HSPLdev/citali/lunartune/MainActivity;->onStart()V
HSPLdev/citali/lunartune/MainActivity;->onResume()V
HSPLdev/citali/lunartune/MainActivity;->**(**)**
Ldev/citali/lunartune/MainActivity**;

# ---- Navigation + top-level UI scaffolding --------------------------------
HSPLdev/citali/lunartune/ui/screens/NavigationBuilderKt;->**(**)**
Ldev/citali/lunartune/ui/screens/**;

# ---- Scroll-driven nav bar hide (per-frame hot path) -----------------------
# NavBarScrollTracker.consume() runs once per scroll frame for the whole of a
# user gesture, with the NestedScrollConnection's onPostScroll/onPreFling/
# onPostFling overrides running alongside it, so both need AOT compilation and
# not merely class loading: an interpreted consume() at 120Hz is exactly the
# jank this feature exists to avoid. The tracker is a top-level class in the
# root dev.citali.lunartune package, which the App** and MainActivity** rules
# above do not reach, so it needs its own entry. The connection is MainActivity's
# single anonymous NestedScrollConnection, addressed through the MainActivity$**
# inner-class wildcard with the method names pinned so the rule does not drag in
# every lambda class of a 3.7k-line composable.
Ldev/citali/lunartune/NavBarScrollTracker;
HSPLdev/citali/lunartune/NavBarScrollTracker;->**(**)**
HSPLdev/citali/lunartune/MainActivity$**;->onPostScroll(**)**
HSPLdev/citali/lunartune/MainActivity$**;->onPreFling(**)**
HSPLdev/citali/lunartune/MainActivity$**;->onPostFling(**)**

# ---- Home screen ------------------------------------------------------------
# HomeScreen and the main SearchScreen live directly in ui/screens in LunarTune,
# not in ArchiveTune's old ui/screens/home package.
HSPLdev/citali/lunartune/viewmodels/HomeViewModel;->**(**)**
HSPLdev/citali/lunartune/ui/screens/HomeScreenKt;->**(**)**
HSPLdev/citali/lunartune/ui/screens/SearchScreenKt;->**(**)**
HSPLdev/citali/lunartune/ui/screens/NavigationBuilderKt;->**(**)**
Ldev/citali/lunartune/ui/screens/HomeScreenKt;
Ldev/citali/lunartune/ui/screens/SearchScreenKt;

# ---- Library / playlists / search ------------------------------------------
